definitions.explanation: A traditional way of doing things that has become established over time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{慣習|かんしゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧。
⟦{社会的|しゃかいてき}→社会的：04791_shakaiteki⟧{慣習|かんしゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{従|したが}う→従う：02059_shitagau⟧。
{慣習|かんしゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{破|やぶ}る→破る：02321_yaburu⟧。

notes:
{慣習|かんしゅう} means custom or convention - established practices passed down in a society or group.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {慣習|かんしゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{従|したが}う→従う：02059_shitagau⟧: to follow custom
- {慣習|かんしゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧: to preserve customs
- {慣習|かんしゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{破|やぶ}る→破る：02321_yaburu⟧: to break with convention
- ⟦{社会的|しゃかいてき}→社会的：04791_shakaiteki⟧{慣習|かんしゅう}: social conventions
- {慣習|かんしゅう}⟦{法|ほう}→法：13620_hou⟧: customary law

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {慣習|かんしゅう}: custom, convention (societal practices)
- ⟦{習慣|しゅうかん}→習慣：01429_shuukan⟧: habit (personal, daily routines)
- ⟦{風習|ふうしゅう}→風習：05826_fuushuu⟧: customs, traditional practices (often regional)
- ⟦{伝統|でんとう}→伝統：09585_dentou⟧: tradition (broader, cultural heritage)
- ⟦しきたり→しきたり：14951_shikitari⟧: customs, conventions (often unwritten rules)
